WF-03 Step Final — Git merge for run WF03-prod-audit-20260527.

Prerequisite: step-03 (TEST-RUNNER) must be COMPLETED with status PASS.
Read docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md in full before starting.

1. Confirm you are on branch feature/WF03-prod-audit-20260527:
   git branch --show-current

2. Fetch and rebase on latest main:
   git fetch origin main
   git rebase origin/main
   (resolve any conflicts, then git rebase --continue)

3. Run final build verification after rebase:
   zig build
   (must exit 0)

4. Push the feature branch:
   git push origin feature/WF03-prod-audit-20260527

5. Create the pull request:
   gh pr create --title "WF03-prod-audit-20260527: Fix 10 production audit issues" --body "Resolves ISS-0031 through ISS-0040 from production audit.\n\nChanges:\n- ISS-0031: Wire real API routes in main.zig (replace placeholder server)\n- ISS-0032: Fix rowToDefinition to deserialize graph JSONB from DB rows\n- ISS-0033: Fix hardcoded exported_at in export/import to use real timestamp\n- ISS-0034: Fix stale pg-stub comment in pool.zig\n- ISS-0035: Wire adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig into integration test suite\n- ISS-0036: Add EE-03 TaskStore integration test coverage\n- ISS-0037: Add EE-03/EE-04 Tasks API integration test coverage\n- ISS-0038: Implement TC-DB-02-01 and TC-DB-02-02 unit tests\n- ISS-0039: Implement TC-ES-01-05, TC-ES-01-06, TC-ES-03-02, TC-ES-03-03\n- ISS-0040: Add API-05 instance history integration test coverage" --base main

6. Merge the PR:
   gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch

7. Record the merge commit hash and PR number in this handoff result.
acceptance_criteria: Feature branch rebased on latest main
PR created and merged via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
Merge commit hash recorded in result
